findings.recommendation: Use crypto.randomUUID() or window.crypto.getRandomValues() for unpredictable, secure identifier generation.
findings.summary: Math.random() is cryptographically predictable and prone to collisions when used for identifiers or security values.
findings.title: Insecure pseudo-random number generator used for identifier generation

findings.recommendation: Sanitize user inputs and wrap items in explicit boundary tags (e.g. <user_note>...</user_note>) before injecting into model context.
findings.summary: User note contents are concatenated directly into the AI context without boundary delimiters or sanitization, risking prompt injection and context poisoning.
findings.title: Client-side prompt context constructed via raw text concatenation
